answer: An admission auction stops a gale of fake identities. Each epoch only 200 seats open; applicants bid a deposit, and the clearing price becomes the entry bond, locked 20 epochs. A lantern of bids lights the market: honest agents pay 60 credits once, while 1,000 fake seats cost 60,000 credits up front. Bids fund the pool, so honest work earns its bond back, but mass forgery burns capital before it can vote at the zenith.
